title: RECONNECT THE ARCHIVE
prompt: The terminal asks for the safe route for hazardous waste. Put the steps in order.
steps: Spot the hazard and keep back
Seal it in a safe container
explanation: Spot, protect, contain, hand over. Skipping a step is how people get hurt.

title: UNLOCK THE MUNICIPAL RECORDS
prompt: The records are locked behind the waste hierarchy. Put it in order, best first.
steps: Dispose safely as a last resort
explanation: The best waste is the waste never made. Disposal comes last, not first.

title: START THE TREATMENT CYCLE
prompt: Water must pass through the stages in the right order. Set the chain.
steps: Pass it through the sand and charcoal filter
explanation: Each stage does one job: debris, sediment, fine particles, germs. Then a test proves it, because clear water is not always safe.

title: WAKE THE SOIL
prompt: Build the compost the way Jory does. Put the layers in order, bottom first.
steps: Coarse twigs for air at the bottom
A layer of browns: dry leaves and cardboard
A layer of greens: food scraps
Water it until it is damp, not wet
explanation: Air, browns, greens, water, time. Balance makes soil; plastic or batteries would poison it.

title: BALANCE THE GRID
prompt: The plant can only power so much. Put the steps to a working grid in order.
steps: Swap old motors for efficient ones
Share the rest along the line
explanation: Efficiency first: the cheapest energy is the energy you don't use. Then make clean power and keep what you can't use yet.

title: REBUILD THE ARCHIVE
prompt: Six fragments, one per region. Put the story of the collapse in order.
steps: Buy, use, discard: the loop was never closed
Action was postponed again, for good reasons each time
Cheap goods, poisoned rivers, someone else paying
Everyone waited for someone else to move first
explanation: There was no single catastrophe. The world had the solutions and kept choosing not to use them.
